name: Spacebring
description:
Spacebring connects Claude to your coworking space management platform, giving you instant access to your business' operational data for reporting, member support, and day-to-day decision-making.

Spacebring helps coworking space operators deliver superior member service through automated operations, built-in AI, and an admin mobile app. The platform helps operators serve customers faster, reduce admin chores, and streamline operations, while delivering a seamless branded customer experience to sign up, book, pay, and get support with ease. 

This connector lets Claude query your live Spacebring data directly in conversation, so you can ask questions, get answers without switching tools or building reports manually.

Key features:
• Pull details on your network and every location you operate, including configuration and status.
•  Look up members and companies in your network, including their details and account status.
•  Access contracts and the templates behind them, useful for audits, renewals, and legal review.
•  Review active subscriptions and the membership plans tied to them.
•  Retrieve invoice records for billing checks, reconciliation, and reporting.
•  Query benefit categories, individual benefits, and member benefit applications.
•  Look up shop categories, products, and orders for on-site retail or add-on services.
•  Access member-facing guides and resources published in your network.

This is not an exhaustive list — we're continuously adding new data types and capabilities to this connector.

This connector is read-only today: it's built for retrieving and analyzing data, not making changes to your Spacebring account. Future updates will expand coverage further and eventually support write actions (like updating records or triggering workflows) directly from Claude.

Built by the Spacebring team for the Spacebring family.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spacebring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spacebring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.spacebring.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spacebring MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spacebring lists 29 MCP tools, including getBenefit, getBenefitApplication, getBenefitApplications, getBenefitCategories, getBenefitCategory, getBenefits, getContract, getContracts, getCustomer, getCustomers, getGuide, and getGuides.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spacebring?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Spacebring in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Spacebring requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Spacebring is developed by Spacebring. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
